coordinate_frame: assembly: X along the dock (plug end at low X), Y toward the lid, Z up

groups.accessory: Polar plug positioner on a 75-mm face-clamp pivot, socket, endstop and printed clamps
groups.centre: Two-piece centre splice ring with integral support foot and cassette fork
groups.plenum: Inner plenum halves with bonded scalloped shiplaps

parts.name: M1-outer-cradle-shell
parts.note: Broad outside X face on bed, cavity open upward. Continuous outer shiplap tongue bonds the plenum halves without airway bosses.

parts.name: M1-inner-shell
parts.note: Broad outside X face on bed, cavity open upward. Fan screws terminate in blind flange pilots outside the air wall.

parts.name: M1-contact-cassette
parts.note: One-piece 16-mm-wide H contact cassette, plug end: R2/V5-C seat and 64-mm underside wall, both built 2 mm upward and joined by a 4-mm deck bridge; one transverse lock pin.

parts.name: M1-insert-pin
parts.note: 36-mm one-notch fan pin as the peg lock: through the outer wall, fence foot, web and seat foot; 0.15-mm cam offset seats both pegs.

parts.name: M2-inner-shell
parts.note: Broad outside X face on bed, cavity open upward. Continuous outer shiplap tongue bonds the plenum halves without airway bosses.

parts.name: M2-outer-cradle-shell
parts.note: Broad outside X face on bed, cavity open upward. Fan screws terminate in blind flange pilots outside the air wall.

parts.name: M2-contact-cassette
parts.note: One-piece 16-mm-wide H contact cassette, far end: R2/V5-C seat and 15-mm fence, both built 2 mm upward and joined by a 4-mm deck bridge; one transverse lock pin.

parts.name: M2-insert-pin
parts.note: 36-mm one-notch fan pin as the peg lock: through the outer wall, fence foot, web and seat foot; 0.15-mm cam offset seats both pegs.

parts.name: accessory-socket-body
parts.note: Replaceable external 30 x 40 mm accessory receiver. Print on its broad closed mounting flange with the cavity upward, then epoxy its shallow perimeter tongue into the plug-end cradle recess.

parts.name: plug-holder-clamp-shoulder
parts.note: Stationary large-shaft clamp shoulder: socket stem and bridge, twelve-rib skirt to a backing ring on the cradle plug-end face, and a hollow 75-mm shaft offset 45 mm lidward of the socket with a smooth journal and an outboard flat-crested 72-mm x 3-mm thread. Print shaft axis vertical, ring on the bed: the skirt narrows upward, the ribs rise at 50 degrees and the thread prints vertically.

parts.name: plug-holder-polar-inner-arm
parts.note: Radial arm on a 70-mm clamped base disc with a 50.5-mm bore running on the smooth journal; the telescoping tongue springs from outside the 50-mm shaft, 20 mm deep in X from r 40. The knurled nut locks the angle by face friction, not by the thread. Prints flat, disc on the bed, tongue standing 20 mm.

parts.name: plug-holder-polar-outer-arm
parts.note: Telescoping outer arm with two spaced captive-head length clamps and a 36-mm tip clevis. The paired clamps prevent yaw; the docking push itself is taken by the cam plate.

parts.name: plug-holder-polar-plug-rotor
parts.note: Plug carrier, 18.8 mm wide: eye on the tip pivot, bar and plate beside the sleeve, and a carrier block in the plug frame (rolled -28.6 deg) with a 14 x 13 mm window that clamps the overmold on its flats, a 10-mm wall carrying a captured scalloped nut and an M8 x 3 printed pinch screw, and an 18-mm bearing land under the window on the pivot side so its back face bears on the cam lobe over several hundred square millimetres; long edges rounded r 3.5, front face chamfered 1.5, window mouth flared 1.5 mm. Prints eye, plate and block face down, window vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-rotor-pinch-shim
parts.note: Loose 7-mm flat bearing shim in the carrier window: the pinch screw tip seats in the round recess on its back and its flat front bears on the overmold flat, so the plug is held on its flats and cannot roll. Print recess face down.

parts.name: plug-holder-rotor-pinch-screw
parts.note: Printed M8 x 3 pinch screw for the plug carrier, 16-mm shank with a flat tip that seats in the bearing shim. Print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-rotor-pinch-nut
parts.note: Captured printed scalloped nut for the carrier pinch screw; drops into the matching pocket on the carrier wall, which keys its scallops. Print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-clamp-cam-spatula
parts.note: Leaf-lobe spatula: 14-mm plate on the journal outboard of the arm disc, pinched by the same nut. Rotate it until its spiral edge runs up to the plug boot; the rotor block then bears face to face on it, back face to lobe face, when the laptop pushes the plug. Prints flat.

parts.name: accessory-socket-clamp-bolt
parts.note: M12-class printed clamp bolt with 3-mm-pitch trapezoidal thread; print thread axis vertical. Broad socket faces carry the accessory load, while this bolt removes play.

parts.name: accessory-socket-clamp-nut
parts.note: Replaceable printed coarse-thread hex nut for the plug-end accessory socket; print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: laptop-slide-endstop-screw
parts.note: Independent printed M10 laptop slide endstop, adjustable +/-4 mm; prints thread axis vertical and sets docked depth without using the USB-C plug as the hard stop.

parts.name: laptop-slide-endstop-soft-tip
parts.note: Replaceable flexible printed bumper for the laptop slide stop; 8.2-mm socket over the screw stem, nominal contact face at X=0.

parts.name: plug-holder-clamp-nut
parts.note: Knurled 100-mm clamp nut on the outboard 72-mm x 3-mm flat-crested thread. Tightening squeezes the cam plate and the arm base against the stationary shoulder; the angle is held by face friction over the 75-90-mm annulus, not by the thread. Print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-tip-annular-screw
parts.note: Small hollow printed pivot screw with captive annular head; prints thread axis vertical and clamps plug-axis alignment at the arm tip.

parts.name: plug-holder-tip-annular-nut
parts.note: Replaceable coarse-thread annular nut captured at the plug-end clevis; print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-clamp-pressure-washer
parts.note: Keyed pressure washer between the nut and the cam plate. Two tabs ride in the journal keyways so it stays with the shaft while the nut turns against it; replace when worn.

parts.name: plug-holder-tip-head-thrust-washer
parts.note: Printable annular thrust washer: lets the fastener turn without twisting or galling the pivot cheek; replace when worn.

parts.name: plug-holder-tip-nut-thrust-washer
parts.note: Printable annular thrust washer: lets the fastener turn without twisting or galling the pivot cheek; replace when worn.

parts.name: plug-holder-length-clamp-1-screw
parts.note: Printable arm-length clamp screw 1; print thread axis vertical. Captive head cannot fall out when reach is adjusted.

parts.name: plug-holder-length-clamp-1-nut
parts.note: Replaceable captive nut for arm-length clamp 1; print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: plug-holder-length-clamp-2-screw
parts.note: Printable arm-length clamp screw 2; print thread axis vertical. Captive head cannot fall out when reach is adjusted.

parts.name: plug-holder-length-clamp-2-nut
parts.note: Replaceable captive nut for arm-length clamp 2; print thread axis vertical.

parts.name: front-tie-L
parts.note: Male T tongue prints broad top down; female socket floor prints base down. Shoulder bearing carries longitudinal load; 0.3-mm mating clearance.

parts.name: front-frame-L-pin
parts.note: Round pin with one longitudinal chord flat on the bed; axis and tension path lie in the layers. Head edge notch count identifies the length.

parts.name: front-frame-L-key
parts.note: Flat XY print; two 1.2-mm locking leaves flex in the layer plane. Pin carries the load; barbs retain the removable key.

parts.name: front-tie-R
parts.note: Male T tongue prints broad top down; female socket floor prints base down. Shoulder bearing carries longitudinal load; 0.3-mm mating clearance.

parts.name: front-lap-key

parts.name: centre-contact-cassette
parts.note: Removable narrow H cassette dressed to the centre fork: 2-mm-raised seat plus the short exit-side fence profile, joined by a 4-mm deck bridge. The upper ring retains the support foot and fork.

parts.name: splice-ring-upper
parts.note: Primary centre splice: alternating M1/M2 shell laps plus the fork, hinge pad and centre desk foot for the removable short H contact cassette. Bonds to both plenum halves; print on the larger flange face with localized supports under the opposing flange and fork.

parts.name: splice-ring-lower
parts.note: Lower closure for the centre splice: fan-side and floor arcs fused as one piece, with the two retained half-lap peg/socket junctions registering it to the upper ring.
